summary: Frontend-only testing of new 'Compartir Racha' feature in guest mode + regression of 'Compartir Entreno'. Seeded 3 guest sessions (today, -7d, -14d) via localStorage 'gymtrack_guest_sessions'. All acceptance criteria pass: streak card visible, count shows '3 semanas seguidas', share button opens modal, preview img has blob src with 1080x1350 dims, download triggers file 'racha-gymtrack.png' + success toast, and the existing session-detail share flow still works (regression OK).
critical_code_review_comments: Home.js openShare could leak previous object URL if user reopens without closing; consider revoking prior shareUrl before creating a new one.

doDownload should probably also work if navigator.share is aborted after user chose share (currently it does, no issue). Minor: canvasToBlob may resolve null on failure; consider handling that case with an error toast.
seed_data_creation: 3 guest sessions seeded in localStorage under 'gymtrack_guest_sessions' (offsets 0/7/14 days) to simulate 3-week streak.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To test Compartir Racha in guest mode: navigate to /, then in the same browser context execute localStorage.setItem('gymtrack_guest_sessions', JSON.stringify([...])) with sessions across consecutive weeks, reload. Selectors: home-streak-card, home-streak-count, home-streak-share-btn, streak-share-modal, streak-share-preview-img, streak-share-confirm-btn, streak-share-download-btn. Preview img dims should be 1080x1350 and src prefix 'blob:'.
